RaceName: Free Bets On attheraces.com EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands C & D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Modest form over C&D on debut and much better when front-running second of ten in novice at Newbury (6f, good to firm; well backed) three weeks ago; drawn wide but still looks a serious contender.

RaceName: Free Bets On attheraces.com EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands C & D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Low-level form at big odds in all four starts, including a seller.

Now only 1lb higher than when beginning this season with 1m4f AW win in April but looked out of sorts on last two outings; swapped usual cheekpieces for new visor last time; goes without any headgear today.

Signed off for Ian Williams with below-par AW run in the autumn and finished last on both turf starts for new stable this year; on good mark now but needs first-time tongue-tie to aid a return to form.

Battled well to win apprentice jockeys' race from the front at Sandown (1m2f, good to firm) on Friday and is now 3-4 for George Baker; escapes a penalty here and will be fine over the longer trip; makes obvious appeal.

Held on gamely to cause 66-1 shock on Flat return at Salisbury (1m4f, good) in May but was safely held on both subsequent outings and is far too inconsistent to support with confidence; had recent wind op.

Scored at Bath in May and was one of two to pull clear of the others when close second of four off today's mark at Nottingham (also 1m6f, good to firm) last month; didn't fire on latest outing but this drop back in trip won't be a problem if he's back on song.
Three-time winner at Newcastle (5f-6f); fair debut effort for this yard but then finished last at Southwell on his return from a break.

Probably failed to stay 7f last time and won a C&D handicap the time before; however, he's got a lot on his plate at these weights.
Has gained his wins over 6f on turf and 7f on AW; inconsistent since last success but has a chance on these figures now into a claimer if in form after his break (yard debut); drawn wide.
Three wins at 6f, two on Polytrack; inconsistent and not well drawn for a front-runner.
Made all for clearcut success in C&D novice last month but only fifth to Jungle Drums next time and he's not weighted to reverse those placings.
C&D winner in April and only a length behind Hockney last time at Kempton when conceding 8lb to that rival; has a bad draw but still has to be considered at these weights.
A bit to prove in the reapplied visor and back over 6f, with his last win coming at 7f; badly drawn last time at Chester but disappointed the run before as well.
Unfavourably treated on these terms but he's in form after back-to-back handicap wins at 6f; should give his running.
Eight-race maiden having his first run at anything shorter than 7f and blinkers are tried; one of the lowest rated in the field.
1m AW win in France in March; downgraded into a claimer after three heavy defeats in handicaps for this yard (6f-1m).
Launched career with two 7f AW wins at Wolverhampton during the winter; absent since close second of four at Southwell (1m) in February but has scope for improvement in turf handicaps.

Did not need to improve to made all at skinny odds in Yarmouth maiden (first-time cheekpieces) last month, her fifth start, but finished well down the field on subsequent handicap debut at Ascot (also 1m, good to firm) and now has a point to prove.

OwnerName: M H Dixon & J L Rowsell
Spotlight: Bounced back quickly from a below-par AW run to win narrowly over C&D (good to firm) a fortnight ago and is now 2-9; recent 5lb rise demands more from her but she ought to give another good account.

Largely consistent filly who came good at 11th attempt, with win from off the pace at Windsor (1m, good to firm; second a next-time-out winner) last month; only 3lb higher here and likely to play another major role.

RaceName: Free Digital Racecard At raceday-ready.com Handicap
Spotlight: Best of her four runs was on debut over 1m on the AW; beaten double-digit lengths in her subsequent races and was easy to back at 7-1 on handicap debut 19 days ago; bred to be better than this but reservations for now.

RaceName: Free Digital Racecard At raceday-ready.com Handicap
Spotlight: Not close to troubling the judge in his four races, last time always out the back on handicap debut at Windsor (1m2f; 10-1); in good hands but hard to be confident about him right now.

RaceName: Free Digital Racecard At raceday-ready.com Handicap
Spotlight: Didn't look straightforward as he ran in snatches before finishing well for a near miss over C&D two months ago; still lightly raced so he might yet iron out those quirks.

Spotlight: In cheekpieces/tongue-tie for the first time when a nose winner at Ffos Las and his run the following week at Lingfield was too bad to be true (completely tailed off); has a chance on that winning form, being only 3lb higher.

Spotlight: Beat Crown Inn To Win over C&D in April and was second to that horse on her return visit, after which she was again runner-up back here; Thirsk was disappointing but could bounce back from that.

Spotlight: Qualifying runs at 7f; didn't improve for stepping up to 9.4f on her handicap debut here when 20-1; plenty to prove, though there are 1m4f winners in the family.

Spotlight: Gelded ahead of his handicap debut at Nottingham (1m2f) but went off 33-1 and trailed in last.

RaceName: Free Digital Racecard At raceday-ready.com Handicap
Spotlight: C&D winner in April off 5lb lower (in this first-time headgear combination) and wasn't far away next time at Haydock, since when he's had a wind operation; every chance if the break doesn't hold him back.

RaceName: Free Digital Racecard At raceday-ready.com Handicap
Spotlight: His close fourth over C&D three runs back gives him similar claims to Goldfinder; soft ground a feasible excuse next time and he was out of the weights last week at Ascot; in this weaker company he's entitled to run well.

RaceName: Free Digital Racecard At raceday-ready.com Handicap
Spotlight: Heavy defeats to begin with and only sixth of ten when 22-1 for handicap debut here at this trip; has to step up.

RaceName: Free Digital Racecard At raceday-ready.com Handicap
Spotlight: Low-key form for Richard Hughes, including four handicaps; changed hands for 6,000gns.

0-11 but he has shown winning potential and he wasn't beaten far over C&D two weeks ago; another bold bid expected.

Improved for the switch to handicaps when winning a five-runner race at Salisbury (7f, good) last month; no progress twice since and connections now reach for cheekpieces.
